newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cartel office bars takeover of Kali & Salz.
newsitem.headline: German cartel office bars takeover of Kali & Salz.

text.p: The German Cartel Office on Friday barred the planned takeover of Kali & Salz by Canada's Potash Corp. of Saskatchewan Inc., citing a possible dominance of the German potash fertiliser market.
Kali parent BASF AG said it would appeal the decision to German Economics Minister Guenther Rexrodt.
German cartel office bars takeover of Kali & Salz
BASF, which planned to sell 51 percent of Kali shares, said it reacted to the ruling with "shock and a lack of understanding" because Potash was not active in Germany.
The cartel office's decision was based on "theoretical considerations" about potential competition, BASF said.
The chemcial group would use a provision in German law that allows companies to appeal the decision to the economics ministry as well as in court.
Rexrodt could clear the way for the deal to proceed.
